name: g
description: Use focused Git and GitHub workflows to create commits, manage issues and reviews, diagnose Actions failures, publish releases, manage stacked PR plumbing, and open draft pull requests.

interface.longDescription: G provides focused workflows for Git commits, GitHub issues, single- and multi-repository triage, technical investigations, pull request review threads, Actions failures, releases, stars, stacked PR plumbing, and single-PR or stacked-PR sending. It uses direct git for local work, the GitHub connector for supported remote operations, and gh only for connector gaps or the explicit gh-stack extension wrapper.
defaultPrompt: Triage this repository's open issues and pull requests.
Diagnose and fix the failing GitHub Actions checks.
Publish these local changes as a safe draft pull request.
